$comment: grimoire.config.json — the project's harness configuration. Written by /grimoire:setup, read by /orchestrate. Keep it at the project root.

requireHook.name: rtk hook claude
requireHook.check: command -v rtk && rtk hook check "git status" | grep -q '^rtk '
requireHook.fix: brew install rtk-ai/tap/rtk && rtk init -g, then restart the session

gate.run: npm run smoke:android && npm run smoke:ios
